policy.VERIFIED: Allowed for primary evaluation and training.
policy.HIGH_CONFIDENCE_WEAK: Potentially usable for training with appropriate weighting (e.g., highly persistent flares).
policy.WEAK: Use cautiously; preferably not for primary test sets.
policy.AMBIGUOUS: Do not use as standard supervised labels.
policy.UNKNOWN: Do not use as a known class unless there is a defensible verified label. Suitable for OOD testing and abstention logic.

reasoning: Without ANY 'VERIFIED' ground-truth labels and 88% of data sitting in 'UNKNOWN', training a production-grade multi-class ML model is scientifically indefensible. The dataset is currently highly imbalanced. To proceed, manual annotation or integration of an authoritative verified incident database is mandatory.
